questions.question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

First row- 12, 19, 26

Second row- 28, 35, 42

Third row- 39, 46, ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: 'Row wise'**

First row → [(First no.), (First no. + 7), (First no. + 14)]

**First row- 12, 19, 26 →**

⇒ [(12), (12 + 7), (12 + 14)]

**Second row- 28, 35, 42 →**

⇒ [(28), (28 + 7), (28 + 14)]

Similarly,

**Third row- 39, 46, ? →**

⇒ [(39), (39 + 7), (39 + 14)]

⇒ (39, 46, **53**)

Here, the question mark(?) is replaced by **53.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (3)".

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word.

Paradise : Heaven :: Faith : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic:** Words are synonyms of each other.

 
• Paradise : Heaven → Paradise is synonym of Heaven.

Similarly,

 
• Faith : ? → Faith is synonym of Belief.

Hence, '**Belief**' is the correct answer.

questions.question: Marks of five students Virat, Kamal, Anil, Sanjay and Rahul are compared. Marks of no two students are same. Marks of Anil are less than only two students. Marks of Kamal are not less than anyone. Marks of Sanjay are more than Anil and less than Kamal. If marks of Rahul are more than the marks of Virat, then marks of how many students are less than the marks of Virat?
questions.solution:
Marks of five students **Virat, Kamal, Anil, Sanjay and Rahul** are compared. Marks of no two students are same.

1. Marks of Anil are less than only two students.

__ > __ > Anil > __ > __

2. Marks of Kamal are not less than anyone.

Kamal > __ > Anil > __ > __

3. Marks of Sanjay are more than Anil and less than Kamal.

Kamal > Sanjay > Anil > __ > __

4. If marks of Rahul are more than the marks of Virat.

Kamal > Sanjay > Anil > Rahul > Virat

Clearly, 0 students got less than the marks of Virat.

Hence, '**0**' is the correct answer.

questions.question: G, H, I, J and K are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. G is sitting to the immediate right of H. J is sitting between K and H. Who is sitting to the immediate left of K?

**Explanation : **

1) G is sitting to the immediate right of H.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5793ff58382b0ea1484336915b3018043254a595c5a9f6757ee691c27e90a9f4.png]
